notes: Fix deploy/getting-started.sh reliability issues found while getting the Hetzner MQTT broker fully working: (1) copy Let's Encrypt cert files instead of bind-mounting the live/ symlinks, which dangled inside the container; (2) fix a Docker VOLUME-shadowing bug where chown against /mosquitto/log silently no-op'd because only the parent directory was bind-mounted, leaving the broker unable to open its own log file and stuck in a permanent restart loop; (3) mount the host CA bundle for the printed Docker test command; (4) drop the unreliable docker-run mosquitto_sub/pub fallback test command in favor of pointing users at MQTT Explorer or a mobile MQTT app. No firmware changes.
